name: Smarter online IS retrieval exploration
partition: Strided question partition across three free cards; all arms and seeds of each question on one card; baseline arms rerun.

policies.resume: Original query and 128/512 positions; append explicit continuation instruction after each 256-token packet.
policies.anchored: Resume format, fixed 128/512; remove answer-format boilerplate from query; 0.75 question-only +0.25 branch-aware reciprocal rank fusion, k8 each, RRF constant20; exclude >50% overlapping previous source windows.
policies.boundary: Anchored retrieval + continuation; check generated prefixes at64/96/128/160 then320/352/.../544, inject at first sentence/newline boundary or deadline; maximum one per phase.
policies.adaptive: Boundary policy; early evidence as above, late insertion only if last32-token mean surprisal>=0.8 nats or uncertainty phrase in recent256tokens; otherwise skip.

limits: All original IS parameters, source files and model settings unchanged. Max2 evidence packets; continuation instruction is additional input cost. No EOS suppression, repair or retry; retain empty/truncated answers.
inference: Exploratory followup on already inspected DEV set; not heldout validation. Policies frozen after ungraded TRAIN integration smoke, before DEV quality scoring.
confounds: Boundary variants change sampling segmentation and therefore backend offset-derived RNG; no claim of identical random streams. Incremental variants alter more than one factor. No confidence interval adjusted for multiple comparisons.
